tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Use when a city, region or island name has to be turned into a place_id (needed by search_hotels, get_hotel_facts and get_price_guide): returns up to 5 matching places with place_id and country. A misspelled name returns the likely places; the match field says whether a place is exact, partial or fuzzy. If several fit, choose by country or ask the user.

query.description: City, region or island name, in any language.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Use when the user wants hotels at a place with specific features (pool, sauna, pets allowed …). All given amenities must match, as stated by the hotels; with few or no results, try fewer amenities. Returns up to 10 hotels with links, ordered by star rating — no prices (see get_price_guide) and no ratings. A notice field carries a condition the user should know (e.g. pets are decided case by case). Halal, kosher, wheelchair access, non-smoking and cribs are not search filters — check them per hotel with get_hotel_facts.

amenities.description: Amenity keys from the list, e.g. pool, sauna, pets-allowed.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

tools.name: get_hotel_facts
tools.description: Use when the user asks what one specific hotel offers (e.g. does it allow pets, is there a sauna, halal food). Returns its amenities as stated by the hotel, with section and origin; extra_charge marks a stated surcharge (no mark means no information, not free). Identify the hotel by its hoteldiscount24.com URL (e.g. from search_hotels), or by name plus place_id; other_matches lists similar names at that place.

name.description: Hotel name, if no URL is known (needs place_id).

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

tools.name: get_price_guide
tools.description: Use for budget questions (what does a night cost in …): typical price range per night (2 adults) at a place, measured from recent searches, with date. For orientation only — current prices for specific dates are on hoteldiscount24.com. has_price_data=false means no reliable data for this place and month.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

tools.name: get_travel_knowledge
tools.description: Use when the user asks about the destination itself rather than a hotel, e.g. the best time to travel or the climate per season: hoteldiscount24's checked travel knowledge for the place, the same text Mercan uses in its chat. has_knowledge=false means there is no checked text for this place and topic — say so, do not guess.

topic.description: Topic: anreise = Getting there & around; ausfluege = Day trips & activities; einkaufen = Shopping & markets; essen = Food & drink; feste = Festivals & events; gut_zu_wissen = Good to know; kunst_kultur = Art & culture; nachtleben = Nightlife & going out; reisezeit = Best time to travel & climate; stadtteile = Neighbourhoods & where to stay; strand = Beaches & swimming; wintersport = Winter sports.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).
